text: The first landing adds a next-line exception before a multiline Preferences import. The immediate follow-up brackets that import with disable and enable directives, which the fixed accepted head retains. The real checkUserPref helper still calls Preferences.get; this is an import exception in a test head, not an API replacement or production permission. The plugin implementation and lint result remain unverified.
title: The enterprise test-head Preferences exception ends after the import
